value.title: The Flying Beast
value.synopsis: Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast.

value.title: Taken
value.synopsis: The boys' imaginations run wild as Dave disappears, when they find him they're convinced he’s a zombie.

value.title: The Curse of MacBeth
value.synopsis: The Chipmunks don't want to perform in the school play, after learning of its curse.

value.title: Zeela the Great
value.synopsis: Simon's robot Geizmo becomes jealous of Jeanette's robot Zeela, until a sudden tragedy reveals Geizmo's true heart.

value.title: Davey Boy
value.synopsis: Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen.

value.title: Dr. Sleep
value.synopsis: In an effort to be more productive, Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep. But does it work?

value.title: The Road Warrior
value.synopsis: Alvin sounds the alarm when he believes Theodore has joined a motorcycle gang of vampires.

value.title: My Fair Chipette
value.synopsis: When Brittany declines Alvin's help for a talent show, he convinces Jeanette to enter, putting them at odds.

value.title: Gone Gal
value.synopsis: When Miss Croner has a disagreement with Miss Miller, she fakes her disappearance to get even.

value.title: Time Traveller's Party
value.synopsis: Simon tells Alvin time travel is impossible, until a man from the future shows up at their home.

value.title: The House on Cedar Lane
value.synopsis: When classmates claim a local haunted house isn't that scary, Alvin decides to prove them wrong.

value.title: Bathroom Bully
value.synopsis: When Miss Smith praises Simon's grades in class, Derek bullies him by not allowing him to use the boys' bathroom.

value.title: Return of Thornbergaupht
value.synopsis: Simon's interactive videogame is about to take off, until Jeanette reprograms the game's villain.

value.title: Squashed
value.synopsis: When Alvin dreams of joining a private club, he volunteers Dave to play squash, even though Dave doesn't play.

value.title: Jinxed!
value.synopsis: After Theodore sees Alvin accidentally ruin Dave's computer, Alvin jinxes Theodore so he won't be able to tattle.

value.title: Writers Block
value.synopsis: When Dave suffers from writer's block, Alvin pretends to write a Broadway show, which only makes Dave feel worse.

value.title: Castle Catastrophe
value.synopsis: After causing an accident at a historic castle, Cheesy and Alvin must work as reenactors to pay for the damage.

value.title: Fire Safety
value.synopsis: When the girls at school develop a crush on the Fire Marshall, Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results.

value.title: The Party Animals
value.synopsis: Alvin books the band at a birthday party only to discover they've been booked as the petting zoo pets

value.title: Warren Seville
value.synopsis: When Alvin tries to break Theodore's dependence on Talking Teddy, Theodore invents a new imaginary friend.
